item.title: Abortion, gay marriage: 4 constitutional amendments approved by Virginia Legislature
item.description: Here are four proposed constitutional amendments approved by the Virginia Legislature reflecting an unabashedly progressive agenda that voters will weigh in on later this year. #Abortion #Samesexmarriage #Virginia #2026election

item.title: Maryland county quits reciting Lord's Prayer before meetings after atheist group protests
item.description: A county government in Maryland has announced that it will stop reciting the Lord’s Prayer at the start of meetings following a complaint from an atheist legal group. #Maryland #atheists #LordsPrayer #OurFather #prayer #FFRF #churchandstate

item.title: ‘The Chosen,’ ‘Sarah’s Oil,’ major studio films earn Movieguide Faith & Values nods
item.description: Major studio franchises such as “Mission: Impossible” and “Superman” will compete alongside faith-driven hits like “The Chosen” and “Sarah’s Oil” at the 33rd annual Movieguide Faith & Values Awards, with nominees announced Tuesday ahead of the Feb. 6 gala in Hollywood. #TheChosen #MissionImpossible #Movieguide #MovieguideAwards

item.title: Christian teacher fired for sharing Evangelical views appeals employment dismissal ruling
item.description: A Christian lecturer was in court this week to appeal a tribunal decision that upheld his dismissal from a Bible college over a social media post expressing traditional Evangelical views on sexuality. #AaronEdwards #homosexuality #Evangelicalviews #discrimination

item.title: Shane Claiborne appears to liken Cities Church protest to Jesus cleansing temple
item.description: Evangelical author and left-leaning activist Shane Claiborne appeared to defend the recent anti-ICE protest at Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota, while likening it to Jesus Christ cleansing the temple. #ShaneClaiborne #CitiesChurch #ICE #Minnesota

item.title: 'We bagged him and put him in the freezer': Ex-Planned Parenthood worker haunted by aborted baby remains
item.description: When Nallely Perez started working for Planned Parenthood, she believed she was stepping into a job that would support her family while she was helping other women. Initially indifferent to abortion, Perez’s views changed the day she was required to rinse and bag the remains of a 16-week-old aborted baby. #PlannedParenthood #redemptionstory #abortiondebate #prolifemovement

item.title: Christian game creator TruPlay accuses Google, TikTok of censorship
item.description: TruPlay Games, a Christian digital media company that creates educational Bible-based video games and entertainment, has accused American technology company Google and popular social media platform TikTok of systematically censoring Christian content and has asked Congress to intervene. #Google #TikTok #TruPlay #Christian #Censorship

item.title: Founding pastor of Cities Church warns 'Christ or chaos' only choices amid growing hostility
item.description: A pastor who helped plant Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota, urged Christians to continue proclaiming the Gospel amid what he discerns as an escalating cultural hostility in the United States, leaving "Christ or chaos" as the only two options. #JoeRigney #TuckerCarlson #CitiesChurch #CREC

item.title: 5 things to know about Trump's Board of Peace
item.description: Here are five things to know about the Board of Peace, which will work to rebuild the war-torn Gaza Strip in the Middle East #DonaldTrump #Israel #Hamas #Davos #Switzerland #MarcoRubio

item.title: JD Vance at March for Life: Abortion debate is a question of choosing either God or paganism
item.description: Vice President JD Vance said in his remarks at the 53rd annual March for Life rally in Washington, D.C., that the debate on abortion is a decision between God or paganism. #JDVance #MarchforLife #paganism #God #abortion #prolife #Trump
